firstSymmetricNormalizationImplementatio.mathematics:
### Unconditional first symmetric-power normalization and finite ramified factors — 7 October 2026

The actual two Hecke roots satisfy the elementary bound |alpha|,|beta| <= |lambda_f(p)|+1 solely from their proved trace and determinant identities. The original cusp coefficient series is already absolutely convergent on Re(s)>1 without Deligne. This controls the sum of the norms of both actual root perturbations and gives an unconditionally convergent order-one spectral product. The true rational Euler denominators are nonzero there; hence both individual root factors and the full infinite denominator are nonzero. For determinant-one local roots alpha and beta, removing the first row and last column of the r-th symmetric tensor square leaves the preceding tensor square and exactly the degree-2r symmetric roots. Actual tensor power traces are squares of real symmetric traces, hence nonnegative. Their formal geometric Euler products therefore have nonnegative coefficients. Prime factorization assembles the actual global coefficients, and explicit polynomial bounds establish a common far convergence half-plane. If these actual even symmetric functions have holomorphic continuations on Re(s)>1, their finite product provides the true tensor continuation. The proved half-plane positivity argument makes the original tensor series absolutely convergent at s=2. Restriction to the injectively indexed prime powers gives convergence of each literal local series. Multiplication by the finite formal denominator gives exactly one. Cauchy-product evaluation of this numerator-one identity at the reciprocal of any root excludes every denominator zero within the disk of convergence; local cancellation is therefore ruled out by proof. For each actual unramified prime p and every r, this bounds both |alpha|^(2r) and |beta|^(2r) by p^2. Unboundedness of powers greater than one and the original determinant identity force |alpha|=|beta|=1, hence |lambda_f(p)|<=2.

The zeroth symmetric Euler function is already holomorphic on Re(s)>1, and the second continuation is already proved. Consequently only higher actual continuations need to be supplied. For the final Sato–Tate reduction, orders r>=3 are explicitly assumed holomorphic and nonzero on Re(s)>=1 and equal to their original Euler products only on Re(s)>r+1. The preceding argument derives actual purity; analytic uniqueness then proves Euler matching on all of Re(s)>1. The already proved first and second nonvanishing cases and the genuine logarithmic-derivative/Tauberian/character chain give the actual weak Sato–Tate limit. No independent Deligne bound, empirical limit, prime-density premise or presumed tensor coefficient positivity is used in this theorem.

inducedSphericalDualEulerImplementation2.mathematics:
### Original induced spherical subquotient and symmetric dual Euler factors — 8 October 2026

Eight further production modules construct the literal finite-orbit span of a group representation and prove that its original action preserves it. The spherical coefficient relation map is proved equivariant and sends each actual induced spherical orbit vector to the corresponding original cusp orbit vector. Its range is the original target cyclic span. The already proved spanning theorem for the original normalized cusp reference therefore gives a genuine surjective intertwiner from the actual Fourier-root induced cyclic subrepresentation onto the entire original smooth local cusp factor at every good prime. Both target irreducibility and this surjection are proved for the original objects. The actual intertwiner kernel is invariant, its literal quotient carries the original quotient action, and the first-isomorphism linear equivalence is proved equivariant. Consequently that actual induced cyclic kernel quotient is equivalent as a group representation to the original irreducible smooth cusp factor. No unitarity of the full induced space, Borel eigenfunctional on the original cusp factor, quotient equivalence, surjectivity or irreducibility is assumed in this original-object conclusion. The existing genuine homogeneous polynomial representation is reused to prove an actual degree-r monomial basis and its full diagonal matrix action. The literal determinant of identity minus X times that original representation matrix is proved equal to the existing symmetric Euler polynomial, with the precise r+1 eigenvalues and exponent order. The actual primitive Fourier-root units supply that same general-linear matrix and are linked to the proved original induced subquotient. At every good prime the original spectral Euler factor equals its genuine symmetric dual determinant factor; at each ramified prime the identical finite omission is retained. The already proved far-half-plane convergence then identifies the entire actual determinant Euler product with the original incomplete symmetric L-function, without Deligne or an added continuation premise.

The original good-prime smooth cusp local factor is now identified as an actual irreducible spherical subquotient of the genuine normalized induced model with its own Fourier roots. Its symmetric dual determinant factors and their genuine incomplete global Euler product agree with the original analytic functions on their proved convergence half-planes. This local representation and Euler normalization does not construct higher automorphic lifts or their analytic continuation, and does not assert irreducibility of the entire principal series. The existing homogeneous matrix substitution and universal coefficient-polynomial modules are generalized from complex coefficients to commutative coefficient rings, retaining their original complex specializations. continuousDeterminantLawImplementation20.mathematics:
### Original determinant family, tensor extension and continuous characteristic coefficients — 8 October 2026

Nine further production modules extend each actual matrix representation to its genuine group algebra and take the literal matrix determinant. Entrywise coefficient maps commute with this original action and determinant. The resulting family is natural under every further coefficient homomorphism, multiplicative, normalized and homogeneous of the actual representation dimension over every coefficient extension. For arbitrary groups, including noncommutative groups, an algebra isomorphism identifies the literal scalar-extended group algebra with the group algebra over the extended ring; it is derived from the original tensor and group bases. The determinant on that literal tensor extension has the exact simple-tensor formula and degree on every tensor; both the tensor identification and its determinant family are natural under every coefficient-algebra homomorphism. The genuine homogeneous symmetric-power representation therefore gives a determinant family of degree n+1, with exact reduction before or after symmetric powers. Evaluating the actual family on X-g is proved equal to the characteristic polynomial of the original group matrix, and this polynomial annihilates that matrix by the existing audited Cayley-Hamilton theorem. No matrix action, coefficient compatibility, determinant identity or tensor equivalence is assumed. Every original characteristic coefficient is the evaluation of an actual universal polynomial in the matrix entries and hence is continuous over any topological coefficient ring. Thus the determinant families of every original continuous representation and its genuine symmetric powers have continuous characteristic coefficients.

These results construct the representation-to-determinant family and its original-object identities. They do not construct the Galois representation associated to the original cusp form, represent a pseudodeformation functor, or prove automorphy lifting. Higher symmetric automorphic lifts and analytic continuation remain open, as do unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato-Tate and the final modular application. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

firstOrderAdjointDeformationImplementati.mathematics:
### Original first-order matrix lifts and actual adjoint cocycles — 8 October 2026

Four further production modules use the pinned actual dual-number matrix equivalence to extract the original ordinary and epsilon components. The original matrix product gives the exact first-order product rule; multiplying the epsilon component by the inverse of the actual reduction gives the adjoint cocycle identity. The original matrix representation defines its actual conjugation representation and the corresponding genuine Mathlib representation-category object. A first-order lift is the literal fiber of genuine dual-number group representations under the actual coefficient-reduction map. Its first-order matrix is proved to belong to Mathlib’s actual adjoint cocycle module. Conversely, every original adjoint cocycle gives the literal matrices rho(g)+epsilon c(g)rho(g); the cocycle identity proves their multiplication law, the group homomorphism gives actual invertible matrices, and their reduction is exactly the original representation. Extracting the cocycle recovers the input cocycle, and reconstructing from a genuine lift recovers that entire original dual-number representation. These explicit inverse constructions give the actual lift/cocycle equivalence.

This is the algebraic first-order lift/cocycle correspondence. Strict conjugacy modulo the actual coboundary module, the resulting H1 classification, continuous deformation conditions and universal deformation representability remain separate obligations. Associated Galois representations, higher symmetric automorphic lifts and analytic continuation remain open, as do unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

strictFirstOrderCohomologyImplementation.mathematics:
### Original strict conjugacy, adjoint first cohomology and continuity — 8 October 2026

Four further production modules construct the literal strict change-of-basis matrix I+epsilon X, prove its explicit inverse, and show that every dual-number invertible matrix reducing to the identity has this form with its original infinitesimal matrix. Actual conjugation changes the original lift cocycle by the exact adjoint coboundary. Equality in Mathlib’s genuine first cohomology is proved equivalent to strict conjugacy of the original first-order representations, and every actual first-cohomology class is represented by an original lift. Separately, for the original continuous representation over a topological coefficient ring, the genuine lift is continuous if and only if its original adjoint cocycle is continuous. Both matrix and inverse coordinates use their actual topologies.

The cohomology classification is algebraic; the separate continuity equivalence does not identify algebraic H1 with continuous cohomology or impose local Selmer conditions. Universal deformation representability, associated Galois representations, higher symmetric automorphic lifts and analytic continuation remain open, as do unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

continuousAdjointAndFixedDeterminantImpl.mathematics:
### Original fixed determinant, continuous first cohomology and restriction — 9 October 2026

Four further production modules derive the exact first-order determinant from Mathlib’s actual determinant expansion. Every original invertible dual-number matrix factors into its strict infinitesimal matrix and the constant inclusion of its original reduction; its determinant has the original determinant as ordinary part and the exact logarithmic trace correction as epsilon part. The original lift has fixed determinant if and only if every original cocycle value has trace zero, giving an explicit equivalence of those fibers. Every original adjoint coboundary has trace zero. The actual continuous adjoint cocycles form a submodule, all actual coboundaries are proved continuous, and their quotient defines genuine continuous degree-one adjoint cohomology. Its equality relation agrees with equality of those classes in the original algebraic H1. Strict conjugacy of original continuous lifts is equivalent to equality in this continuous quotient, and every continuous class is represented by an actual continuous lift. Restriction along the original continuous group homomorphism preserves actual cocycles and coboundaries, descends to a linear map on the genuine continuous quotient and sends each original lift class to the class of its actual restricted representation.

The continuous cohomology construction is the actual degree-one adjoint cocycle quotient. No higher continuous cohomology, Galois-specific finiteness or Selmer vanishing, local p-adic Hodge condition, or universal deformation representability is inferred. Associated Galois representations, higher symmetric automorphic lifts and analytic continuation remain open, as do unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

matrixRepresentationCoordinateAlgebraImp.mathematics:
### Original representation coordinate algebra and its actual universal property — 9 October 2026

Four further production modules construct the actual polynomial coordinate algebra of matrix representations of the original group: one variable for every original matrix entry, with the ideal generated by the literal identity and multiplication equations. These equations are proved in the quotient. Its actual coordinate matrices form a genuine group homomorphism and hence are invertible, giving the actual universal representation. Evaluation at an original representation kills the entire relation ideal and descends to an algebra map; base change of the universal representation recovers that entire original representation. Conversely, evaluating a representation obtained from an original algebra map recovers the whole original algebra map. These two proved inverse constructions give a genuine equivalence over every coefficient algebra, and the coordinate evaluation is natural under coefficient-algebra maps.

This is algebraic representability of framed matrix representations of an abstract group by a concrete, potentially infinitely generated coordinate algebra. It does not prove complete local or Noetherian deformation representability for profinite groups, continuity of the universal representation, pseudodeformation representability, or a quotient by change of basis. Galois association, local p-adic Hodge and Selmer inputs, patching, higher symmetric automorphic lifts and analytic continuation remain open, as do unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.

finiteSymmetricRepresentationParametersI.mathematics:
### Original finite quotients and symmetric-power parameter maps — 9 October 2026

Four further production modules prove that the actual kernel of an original continuous matrix representation over a discrete coefficient ring is open. For an original compact group, its actual kernel quotient is finite; the faithful quotient representation composes with the original quotient map to recover the original representation exactly. The concrete coordinate algebra of a finite group over a Noetherian coefficient ring is Noetherian by the pinned polynomial and quotient results. Consequently, each original continuous discrete representation has its exact evaluation from the actual Noetherian coordinate algebra of its own kernel quotient. Separately, evaluation of the actual symmetric power of the original universal rank-two representation constructs the genuine contravariant map on coordinate algebras. Its universal and original-evaluation identities are proved from the existing coefficient-change theorem. The actual symmetric power of a genuine first-order lift reduces correctly, preserves original strict conjugacy and equality of the original adjoint H1 classes, and retains continuity in the original topology.

The finite kernel quotient may vary with the original representation; no single finite quotient for all deformations is claimed. These finite-group coordinate algebras and genuine symmetric-power maps do not prove complete local profinite deformation or pseudodeformation representability, local p-adic Hodge conditions, Selmer finiteness or vanishing, Galois association, patching, higher automorphic lifts or analytic continuation. Unconditional Deligne, non-CM Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–16 remain accepted; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN.
